root-fg-wet-bridge-repair.json.finding: The simplified section8 FG closure omitted true post-release additions/water uptake/removals and used Q as physical transfer without full origin/current-state bridge. The complete section9 wet-account rule did not make this literal simpler equation universally true.

repairs.old_rule: For each original cohort use opening FG plus unique Q plus actual external returns plus actual rework returns = closing FG plus gross physical dispatch plus actual discard/destructive testing plus actual rework issues, at matched gates. Reinspection/authorization is no new Q. Carry historical vector with every real transfer; reverse original delivery only with linked records and add actual incremental rework once. Services over observed H use original Qc.
repairs.new_rule: For each original cohort independently close the complete actual wet FG ledger: opening FG + actual new first-release transfers + actual external returns + actual rework returns + real independent non-water additions + water uptake = closing FG + gross physical dispatch + actual discard/destructive tests + actual rework issues + real independent non-water removals + water loss. Keep every leg mutually exclusive and on its actual wet state; material already inside a whole receipt/exit/stock is nested, never another addition/removal. Record real additional matter as specific atomic exchanges; do not fit a water/material residual. A new first-release transfer is the actual physical handoff linked to its unique acceptance event and origin-basis bridge, not the denominator Q0 added again. An old cohort with opening already accepted FG has no new release merely because it is observed, dried, returned or dispatched; current-period new manufacture may be zero while original Qc=Q0,c remains positive. Keep paired transfer states and actual later transformations independently; all original acceptance-basis fates reconcile separately under v_ext_cohort_acceptance. Reinspection/authorization makes no new Q. Carry each historical vector once through real transfers and any justified original-delivery reversal, and add only actual incremental service/rework. Full physical movements remain distinct from attributed A; observed services use original Qc and H is never a divisor.

repairs.old_rule: 各原批在匹配门：期初FG加唯一Q加实际外部返回加真实返工返回 = 期末FG加实物总发运加真实丢弃/破坏测试加真实返工领出。复验/授权不新增Q。每次真实交接携带历史向量；原交付仅凭关联记录冲回，真实增量返工只加一次。已观察H内服务使用原Qc。
repairs.new_rule: 逐原批独立闭合完整实际湿基成品账：期初成品+真实新增首次放行交入+真实外部退回+真实返工交回+独立真实非水新增+吸水=期末成品+毛实物发运+真实报废/破坏试验+真实返工交出+独立真实非水移除+失水。全部腿互斥并按实际湿状态；整份接收/出口/库存内已含物质只作嵌套，不能再作增减。真实额外物料按具体原子交换记录，不拟合水或物料残差。新增首次放行交入是真实物理交接，并链接唯一验收事件及来源基准桥，不把分母Q0再加一次。期初已有验收成品的旧批，不因观察、干燥、退回或发运而新增放行；当前期间新增制造可为零，原Qc=Q0,c仍保持正值。成对交接状态及真实后续转化独立保留，全部原验收基准去向另按v_ext_cohort_acceptance核对。复验/授权不新建Q。历史向量沿真实转移及有理由的原交付冲回仅一次，只增加真实增量服务/返工。完整实物与归属A分开；实际服务按原Qc，H不作除数。
